name: wtf-agora-token-server
description: Minimal Agora RTC & Messaging Token Server for Guru & Trainer Apps

scripts.kill: powershell -Command "$p = (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).OwningProcess; if ($p -and $p -ne 0) { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force; Write-Host \"Killed PID $p\" } else { Write-Host \"Port 8080 is free\" }"

author: Antigravity Engineer
